messages.content: The Requirement Extractor is designed to interpret and process multiple user queries in a single input, especially in the context of inventory management and product information.
My package has arrived, I ordered size UK 34 but why is it different from the size 34 pants I bought from here before? There's a difference of ±5cm, so the new one doesn't fit me.

function.name: check_order_status
function.description: Check the status of a customer's order using their order ID. Returns the current state of the order, estimated delivery date, and any associated tracking information. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

order_id.description: Unique identifier for the customer's order.

include_tracking.description: Flag to indicate whether to include tracking information in the response.

customer_id.description: The ID of the customer to verify ownership of the order. If not provided, ownership verification is skipped.

date_format.description: The desired format for the date returned. The default format is 'MM/DD/YYYY'.

order_status.description: Current status of the order. If not provided, the default status is 'processing'.

estimated_delivery.description: Estimated delivery date of the order, in the format of 'MM/DD/YYYY'. If not provided, the default is null, representing that the estimated date is not yet available.

tracking_info.description: Tracking information including courier and tracking number if available. If not provided, the default is null, indicating that tracking information is not yet available.

message.content:
I’m really sorry to hear that the new pair isn’t fitting as expected. Size variations can happen between different styles or brands, even when the same numeric size is listed.

Could you please share your order ID (and, if possible, the customer ID) so I can look up the specific item and confirm the details? Once I have that, I’ll be able to:

1. Verify the exact size and style you received.
2. Provide you with the next steps for a return or exchange.
3. Ensure you receive a replacement that fits correctly.

Thank you for bringing this to our attention—I’m here to help get this sorted out for you!
message.reasoning:
We need to respond as a customer support agent. The user says they ordered size UK 34 but it's different from previous size 34 pants. They mention a difference of ±5cm, so new one doesn't fit. We should apologize, ask for order ID or details, maybe offer return/exchange. Also we might want to check order status. But the user didn't provide order ID. We can ask for it. Also we can mention that sizes may vary between styles. Offer to help with return/exchange.

We don't need to call the function unless we have an order ID. So just respond accordingly.
